Evaluation cohorts and geometric references used for paired initializer-relative evaluation.
Prepared examples by split. The final column identifies the test grouping used for each split.
Model definitions and trainable parameter counts. Counts include the garment image encoder and exclude frozen NLF and RGB parsing.
Training budgets and stage-specific settings. Surface samples are listed per training or validation case.

Primary matched-budget synthetic holdout (SYN-600, 68 garments across 67 audited body groups). Means average body groups and five training seeds (2110–2114); ± reports composite seed SD. Lower values denote higher accuracy (mm).

Opening placement accuracy on the expanded SYN-30 holdout (mm), reported as case-weighted means across 193 garments and three seeds using explicit template loop correspondences under the scale-augmented recipe.

Complete-surface ablation and matched-budget scaling on SYN-30 (mm, case-weighted mean ± SD across 193 garments and three seeds). Standard rows enable metric-scale augmentation U[0.8,1.2]; the clean-scale row (w/o scale aug.) disables it to evaluate in-domain precision. Nested 600-example (-600) and matched 18k-update (-18k) rows verify budget scaling.
CloSe rendered real-scan coverage error (nominal mm, three-seed mean ± SD over 144 test views across 24 scans). The shared CloSe initializer baseline is 55.03 mm (Figure 5).

Captured-photograph coverage error on 4D-DRESS (nominal mm, equal-subject mean ± training-seed SD). Pilot: 2 subjects / 111 patches; CAP-20 supplied mask: 20 unseen subjects / 675 patches; CAP-20 predicted input: 670 validly prepared patches.

Mesh geometric regularity diagnostics on CAP-20 across all three seeds. Reversal measures face-orientation change relative to initialization; collapse measures degenerate faces; log stretch p95 is the mean per-mesh 95th-percentile log edge-length change.
Surface CD sensitivity (mm) under geometric and imaging perturbations on SYN-30 (three-seed means).
Additional synthetic observation tracks on SYN-30 (mm), spanning viewpoint, resolution, mask, focal-length, reinitialization, and cross-style transfer variations.
Captured-photograph coverage under visual and body-prior corruptions on CAP-20 supplied masks (nominal mm, three-seed mean ± SD).
